status.darwin: tccli emr DescribeInstancesList --region ap-guangzhou --version 2019-01-03 --cli-unfold-argument --DisplayStrategy clusterList --Limit 1 >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo 'Authenticated and EMR accessible' || (echo 'Not authenticated or no EMR access' >&2; exit 1)
status.linux: tccli emr DescribeInstancesList --region ap-guangzhou --version 2019-01-03 --cli-unfold-argument --DisplayStrategy clusterList --Limit 1 >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo 'Authenticated and EMR accessible' || (echo 'Not authenticated or no EMR access' >&2; exit 1)
status.win32: powershell -Command "tccli emr DescribeInstancesList --region ap-guangzhou --version 2019-01-03 --cli-unfold-argument --DisplayStrategy clusterList --Limit 1 *> $null; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { Write-Output 'Authenticated and EMR accessible'; exit 0 } else { Write-Error 'Not authenticated or no EMR access'; exit 1 }"
